sections.title: Overview
sections.content: JSONChunking preserves object and array hierarchy while keeping serialized output inside a byte budget. This property is intentionally long enough to compete with sibling properties for space in the same chunk.

sections.title: 混合字符
sections.content: 这一段同时包含中文、English words、日本語、한글、العربية、emoji 🤖🔍✅ 和组合字符 café，用于观察 JSON serialized bytes 与 Unicode runes 的差异。

sections.title: Nested values
sections.content: Deeply nested values exercise the recursive object traversal used by JSONChunking.

sections.title: A property larger than a tiny budget
sections.content: This deliberately long property contains several sentences. A tiny byte budget may not be able to preserve it together with its surrounding object. The strategy must choose a deterministic representation and must never emit invalid JSON. Repeated observations should produce the same ordering and the same chunk boundaries for the same input. 中文内容会占用多个 UTF-8 bytes，因此相同的可见字符数量不代表相同的 serialized byte size。The tail of this property is retained so the viewer can show whether any content disappears during recursive splitting.

records.message: the final record checks array tail preservation
